title: A Koszul-regular closed immersion is perfect
statement: Let Y be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Assume that every point of Y has an affine open neighbourhood U=\operatorname{Spec}A on which the ideal I\subset A of Z\cap U is generated by a finite Koszul-regular sequence of A [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Then i_*\mathcal O_Z is locally quasi-isomorphic to the bounded Koszul complex on that sequence, whose terms are finite free modules. Consequently i is a perfect immersion: i_*\mathcal O_Z is a locally perfect complex on Y [def-pc-perfect-complex].

source.place: Tag 068C, Lemma 37.61.7 (a Koszul-regular immersion of schemes is perfect)
